items.name: Cube Plan Baie 2025
items.information:
L’inscription est **gratuite** pour les **nouveaux compétiteurs** ainsi que les [**adhérents AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Si ce n'est pas votre cas, l'inscription coûte 5€.
Merci de **lire attentivement les conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](#59752-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. 
Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule). 

----
Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€.
Please **read the registration conditions, the [FAQ](#59752-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**.
Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab.

items.name: Rubik's Irish Championship 2025

venue.name: SETU Arena
venue.address: South East Technological University West Campus, Carriganore, Co. Waterford. X91 XD96

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTAwMjEsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c411f6f86bee015155c5df7a3cac70b4a25db3d4/Plain%20Banner%20(1).webp)

**Please Note:** As this is Ireland's National Championship, only competitors who represent Ireland will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

**Final Round Advancements:** For events with more than one round, the top 6 Irish competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the finals in addition to the top 10 remaining best competitors of any region. For 3x3 finals, the top 6 Irish competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the final in addition to the top 6 remaining best competitors of any region.

**Free T-Shirt:** All registered competitors will receive a free t-shirt. Please fill in your t-shirt size in the comment box when registering. More info [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksIrishChampionship2025#59073-t-shirts)

**Fewest Moves Challenge**: FMC will not be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's Irish Championship FMC 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksIrishChampionshipFMC2025) on 9th August instead.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTAwMjIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--57ec822f6c26d275416b8be083d5a991a665ddc2/image.webp)

items.name: Korea Open 2025

venue.name: [보훈재활체육센터 (Bohun Rehabilitation Health Center)](https://rsc.bohun.or.kr/main/)
venue.address: 경기도 수원시 장안구 광교산로 71 (71, Gwanggyosan-ro, Jangan-gu, Suwon-si, Gyeonggi-do)

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODAxMDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--1d45170eaf0bd2a1efc083a1a69d18c72f8b5cdf/unnamed.jpg)

WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaOpen2025#49246-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaOpen2025#49245-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오.

모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지하여야 합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___

If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaOpen2025#49246-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaOpen2025#49245-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering.

All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request.

Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.
